name: factr-agile
description: Decompose scope and shape backlog artifacts using FACTR Core behavioral reasoning.

interface.shortDescription: Decompose scope and shape testable backlog items.
interface.longDescription: Independent Agile refinement using behavioral falsifiability. Decompose product scope or supported system responsibilities; shape epics, features, stories, and observable acceptance criteria while preserving source constraints and uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Use FACTR Agile to decompose this product scope into useful capability slices.
Use FACTR Agile to refine this feature into stories and acceptance criteria.
Use FACTR Agile to propose subsystem allocations from these requirements.
